song: I Bet You Look Good on the Dancefloor
source: Starting point, not official. 2006 rig (musicteacher.com, Mixdown): Alex Turner's white Mexican Strat into an Orange AD30TC set clean, two ProCo RAT 2s (one crunchy, one heavy); the Dancefloor intro uses the Rat. Jamie Cook: '62 Tele into a Hiwatt Custom 50 (LinkedIn article, Equipboard). SqueakDST is assumed to be Zoom's RAT model (FLTR knob); ORG120 is the pedal's only Orange-style amp. Knob values are estimates.
